# Asella Organic

> Premium cold-processed organic health products, ethically sourced from Ethiopian highland farms and delivered with care.

Asella Organic provides 100% natural, chemical-free herbal and wellness supplements including Moringa, Black Seed Oil, Turmeric, Chia Seeds, Frankincense, and Myrrh.

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://asellaorganic.com/): Official storefront and brand introduction.
- [Product Catalog](https://asellaorganic.com/#products): Browse all organic wellness products and package sizes.
- [Our Story](https://asellaorganic.com/#story): Ethical highland farming, community impact, and sustainable harvesting.
- [Order Products](https://asellaorganic.com/#hero): Place single or bulk wholesale orders.
- [Contact Us](https://asellaorganic.com/#contact): Customer support, WhatsApp, Telegram, and inquiries.

- [Full LLM Documentation](https://asellaorganic.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive product specifications, dosages, and company details.

- [Telegram Mini App](https://asellaorganic.com/tma): Direct ordering via Telegram bot.
